'''2010 Canadian Nationals Cole Lepine LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Cole
* '''Deck name:''' Cole Light
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
